name: Plastic Injection Molding | Advance Plastics
old_description: Custom plastic injection molder based in San Diego County, California.
about:
Advance Plastics operates its main plant in National City, California, within San Diego County. The company has accumulated nearly 40 years of industry experience, though a specific founding year is not disclosed. Ownership details and founder names are not publicly stated.

The shop specializes in custom plastic injection molding, running presses ranging from 35 to 1,000 tons of clamping force. It offers low-, medium-, and high-volume production runs and maintains an on-site tool room. Molds are sourced from a trusted supplier, IMS, and carry a lifetime guarantee.

Advance Plastics holds AS9100D certification, indicating a focus on aerospace and defense work. The company also produces parts compliant with NSF and CFR standards, serving customers who require Made-in-USA components. Specific customer names or industry verticals beyond these certifications are not listed.

The company emphasizes its lifetime mold guarantee, on-site tooling capability, and AS9100D quality system as key differentiators. It also highlights a commitment to on-time delivery and domestic manufacturing.
